So a refund is not an option at this point?

Sent from my iPhone

Hi Brian,

No, I'm not telling you a refund is off the table. Your request is with a supervisor and they make that call, not me.

Before it goes further, there's one more thing I can put on the table, and it's the best I have. Keep the order as it stands and we refund $100 of the $839 back to your original payment, so you still get the 40T and some of the money back for the wait. The team approves that one with a click, and I'd ask them to confirm it to you directly. The unit itself is already allocated to you out of the batch being built, and it ships October 31.

The other option still stands too, the full $839 as store credit on your account, usable on anything we have in stock today.

If neither of those works and you want the money back instead, say the word and I'll put the cancellation request in front of a supervisor for review. I can't promise you the outcome or an amount, that is theirs to decide. The team is offline this evening and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you right here in this thread.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi Sarah,
Yes, that works for me. I really appreciate the partial refund along with the free Miner D. and Power K.! I will keep an eye out for the confirmation email from the team tomorrow. Thanks so much for your help with this order.
Thanks,
Brian M.

Hi Brian,

That's great, thank you for staying with us.

Your order stays exactly as it is. The Magic M. 40T, the Harlo OS diagnostics add-on, and the free Miner D. and Power K. are all on it now, nothing more to pay, and they ship together in the same box on October 31. The tracking email goes out to this address automatically the moment it leaves the warehouse.

The $100 partial refund is recorded on your order and sits with the team to process. They're offline overnight and pick it up at 10am Eastern today, and the confirmation lands in your email. Once it goes through, it's back on the card you paid with within 3 to 5 business days.

If you want to follow the batch on its way to us in the meantime, it's here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Glad we could sort this out for you, Brian.

I would like to request a full refund and cancellation of my order. It still hasn’t shipped yet, and now you have changed all the specs so it’s not even the product I was promised. I don’t want to discuss any further discounts or additional gifts. Please cancel my order and issue a full refund. Thank you.

Hi Brian,

Understood, and I'm not going to push anything else on you.

You're right that it hasn't shipped and that it changed. The 40T went through a control board revision at the factory, we wrote about that on November 3, and the ship date on your order now reads November 30 rather than the October 31 you were given. That is a real change and I'm sorry it landed on you after everything else in this thread.

Your request to cancel the order and refund it in full is now with a supervisor for review. Cancelling isn't something I can do myself, so they make that call and they come back to you directly. I'm not going to promise you an outcome or an amount I don't control. What I can tell you is that your request is in front of them with the full history of this order attached, including the $100 already refunded.

The team is offline today and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and their answer comes to you right here in this thread. You don't need to do anything in the meantime.

Sorry it ended up here, Brian.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
